title: 9:16 tight chest-up portrait of an adult
prompt:
9:16 tight chest-up portrait of an adult East Asian woman with a small oval face, moist-looking almond-shaped brown eyes staring directly into the lens as if looking into her lover’s eyes, a straight nose, slightly parted glossy nude-pink lips, fair skin with flushed cheeks, and long black hair falling messily around her face with many loose strands across her cheeks. An atmosphere of restrained desire, as if only a single breath remains between them. A coaxing, pleading mood, her breath almost reaching the frame.

She wears a wide-neck off-white cotton T-shirt. She lifts her face very close to the camera, her eyelids lowered, her moist eyes looking at him as if asking him not to lower the camera. Her lips are glossy and damp; she has just lightly licked the corner of her lips before parting them again. Her cheeks and collarbones are softly flushed. She leans her upper body straight toward the lens, with her left shoulder slightly lower and her collarbone pushed closer to the camera. Completely unposed.

The camera is pushed in extremely close, using a 50mm lens, approximately 28 cm from her face. The subject fills around 93% of the frame, tightly cropped from her hair and cheeks down to her collarbones, with her face positioned slightly left of center. The gray background is completely blurred and indistinct.

Neutral lighting, with highlights catching the moisture on her lips and at the corners of her eyes. The approximate color distribution is 55% skin tones, 21% off-white, 16% black hair, and 8% background. Low saturation, with the bridge of her nose appearing slightly soft due to the extremely close camera distance. Photorealistic snapshot. Do not make negative assumptions.
